about: Care Guides PFA puts on pet-health.html itself (lib/med-notes.js). Guides sent through the page are kept in the admin panel, not here. Each can be taken off the site and put back from the panel, under Care Guides. A guide with a series is shown in that series, in its part order.

series.name: Living with diabetes
series.intro: Start with the condition. Follow with the tools used to monitor it.

notes.title: Diabetes in dogs: what to do
notes.summary: Signs, the tests to ask for, insulin and its starting dose, food and feeding times, low sugar and when it is an emergency. One page, for owners and rescuers in India.
notes.sources: AAHA Diabetes Management Guidelines and veterinary sources

notes.title: Glucose meters for dogs
notes.summary: A comparison of dog-calibrated meters and continuous monitors, where they are sold, their listed prices and the author’s findings on availability in India.
notes.sources: the author’s comparison, prices checked 19 November 2026
